section_summary.extract_value: This Results section presents descriptive statistics and inter-item correlations from Table 1, showing that consideration of cosmetic surgery was significantly correlated with SATAQ-3 subscales and negatively correlated with body appreciation, BMI, and age. A multiple linear regression analysis (F(7, 314) = 41.89, p < .001, Adj. R² = .471) identified body appreciation, Internalisation-General, Information, BMI, and Pressures as significant predictors of cosmetic surgery consideration, with body appreciation being the strongest predictor (β = .35).
